pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You are advising a large e-commerce retailer that wants to build a personalization engine — a system that shows each shopper different product recommendations, emails, and homepage content based on their behavior. Their data science team is strong, but they are facing two hard constraints: a significant portion of their users have opted out of cross-site tracking under new privacy regulations, and their marketing team wants to use a generative AI model to produce personalized email copy at scale. How would you design the personalization architecture to remain effective under the tracking opt-out constraint, and what measurement approach would you use to prove the system is driving incremental revenue rather than just reaching users who would have bought anyway?
